summary: A 1969 note defining the format of host-to-host control messages. Each is a sequence of 8-bit bytes: a control byte followed by parameter bytes, and several messages may share a packet. It lists the nine control messages defined at that point, such as requests to set up connections.

eli5.summary: When two computers set up a conversation they swap small coded notes. This note says how those notes are written down so both sides understand them.

questions: how did early arpanet hosts set up connections
